methodology: Codex independently reopened the official UGI/Argo announcement, UGI's latest Form 10-Q and the Federal Register notice for FERC docket EC26-118-000; checked exact URLs, access status and direct-source content; audited production and evaluated seed for existing identities; and searched for a later close, termination, resale or revised timetable through the as-of date.

verifiedClaims: UGI Utilities, Inc., a wholly owned UGI Corporation subsidiary, agreed to sell its Electric Division to funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP.
The approximately $470 million purchase is subject to working-capital adjustments, customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
The parties expected closing in Q1 calendar 2027.
The business serves more than 63,000 customers through approximately 2,700 miles of transmission and distribution lines and 14 substations in Luzerne and Wyoming counties, Pennsylvania.

sources.verificationNote: The filing was opened by the GPT-5.6 Pro research run and independently corroborated through SEC-indexed current disclosure. Direct curl returned the SEC rate-limit page; the recorded length and hash describe that rate-limit response.

verifiedClaims: FERC docket EC26-118-000 names UGI Utilities, Inc. and Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC as applicants.
The joint Federal Power Act section 203 application was filed on June 26, 2026 under accession 20260626-5274.

exitSearchConclusion: No legal close, termination, resale, replacement buyer or revised closing timetable was identified through August 16, 2026. UGI's latest Form 10-Q and the pending FERC docket support continued signed-pending status.
modelEvidenceCorrections: Use the full-slug Business Wire release rather than the model's shortened /en URL.
Treat UGI Utilities, Inc. as the current legal owner and create no Argo ownership period before closing.
Use UGI Utilities – Electric Division as a manager-level display identity while making clear that the current legal entity is UGI Utilities, Inc.
Use Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC only as the FERC applicant/acquisition vehicle for the same pending target, not as a separate PortCo.
Do not infer an Argo fund, manager-level stake, standalone headquarters, founding year or separate website.
Use the official announcement as the sole primary citation because it directly establishes buyer, seller, business boundary, price, timing and operating scale.
